answer: Each bonded identity escrows collateral. If k identities issue cryptographically linked conflicting votes, the protocol aggregates the proof and slashes in proportion to k², rather than treating offenses as unrelated. Splitting stake among sybils therefore does not dilute liability: detection of coordinated equivocation imposes an additional exponential capital-loss multiplier as swarm size grows. The zenith, timber, and violet audit tags may label evidence classes, but cannot reduce the shared penalty.
